t: 俄罗斯将利沃尼亚割让给波兰-立陶宛联邦.
te: Russia cedes Livonia to the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
dz: 亚姆-扎波尔斯基休战:俄罗斯将利沃尼亚割让给波兰-立陶宛联邦.
de: Truce of Yam-Zapolsky: Russia cedes Livonia to the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

t: 教皇格列高利十三世在教皇敕令 Inter gravissimas 中宣布了公历。
te: With the papal bull Inter gravissimas, Pope Gregory XIII announces the Gregorian calendar.
dz: 教皇格列高利十三世在教皇敕令 Inter gravissimas 中宣布了公历。
de: With the papal bull Inter gravissimas, Pope Gregory XIII announces the Gregorian calendar.

t: 西班牙征服者埃尔南多·德·莱尔马在阿根廷萨尔塔建立了定居点。
te: Spanish conquistador Hernando de Lerma founds the settlement of Salta, Argentina.
dz: 西班牙征服者埃尔南多·德·莱尔马在阿根廷萨尔塔建立了定居点。
de: Spanish conquistador Hernando de Lerma founds the settlement of Salta, Argentina.

t: 日本最强大的大名织田信长被自己的将军明智光秀逼迫自杀。
te: Oda Nobunaga, the most powerful of the Japanese daimyōs, is forced to commit suicide by his own general Akechi Mitsuhid…
dz: 战国时期：日本最强大的大名织田信长被自己的将军明智光秀逼迫自杀。
de: Sengoku period: Oda Nobunaga, the most powerful of the Japanese daimyōs, is forced to commit suicide by his own general Akechi Mitsuhide.

t: 丰臣藏相会击败了相克奇·美慈德.
dz: 山崎会战:丰臣藏相会击败了相克奇·美慈德.
de: Battle of Yamazaki: Toyotomi Hideyoshi defeats Akechi Mitsuhide.

t: 公历由教皇格列高利十三世引入。
te: The Gregorian Calendar is introduced by Pope Gregory XIII.
dz: 公历由教皇格列高利十三世引入。
de: The Gregorian Calendar is introduced by Pope Gregory XIII.

t: 格雷戈里亚日历的通过开始,最终导致几乎普遍通过.
te: Adoption of the Gregorian calendar begins, eventually leading to near-universal adoption.
dz: 格雷戈里亚日历的通过开始,最终导致几乎普遍通过.
de: Adoption of the Gregorian calendar begins, eventually leading to near-universal adoption.

t: 在Stratford-up-Avon中,威廉·莎士比亚和安妮·哈特韦支付40英镑(相当于202…
te: In Stratford-upon-Avon, William Shakespeare and Anne Hathaway pay a £40 (equivalent to £13,818 in 2025) bond in lieu of…
dz: 在Stratford-up-Avon中,威廉·莎士比亚和安妮·哈特韦支付40英镑(相当于2025年的13,818英镑)的债券来代替贴出婚纱布,这使得他们能够立即结婚.
de: In Stratford-upon-Avon, William Shakespeare and Anne Hathaway pay a £40 (equivalent to £13,818 in 2025) bond in lieu of posting wedding banns, which enables them to marry immediately.
